# RETURNHOUSE — P20 interface and design envelopes

## Dimension basis

- Units: mm.
- Dimensions: nominal.
- Diagram convention: separate interface details and maximum envelope views.
- Bottle and cartridge body silhouettes: open.
- Package artwork and carton structure: open.

## Common P20 interface

| Element | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Bottle collar | outer diameter 28; opening diameter 18; collar band 10 high |
| Bottle closure | removable storage closure; exterior design open |
| Refill shoulder | diameter 28 |
| Refill stem | diameter 16; bore 8; insertion depth 14 |

- Interface family: P20 across all four SKUs.
- Correct contents pairing: matching SKU code.

## Maximum external envelopes

| Item | Envelope (mm) | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bottle | 70 W x 65 D x 230 H | nominal capacity 500 mL |
| Refill | 60 W x 32 D x 110 H | concentrate cartridge 20 mL |
| Starter | 145 W x 90 D x 255 H | one dedicated bottle + one refill |

- Envelope extent: body and removable storage closure.
- Surrounding body shapes: open within the stated maxima.

steps.userMessage:
RETURNHOUSE | Concentrate refills for containers worth keeping

We need a household cleaning packaging family for customers who already own our RETURNHOUSE refill station. The direction is fixed: warm off-white #F7F5EF and deep ink #233D45, with a readable SKU code and name beside each accent. The four products are 01 PANE / Glass cleaner, #3C77A0; 02 SURFACE / Surface cleaner, #BD714D; 03 FLOOR / Floor cleaner, #5B7F64; and 04 BATH / Bathroom cleaner, #845E87. Print "RETURNHOUSE" on every bottle, cartridge and starter carton. Distinguish first purchases with "STARTER KIT" and repeat purchases with "REFILL ONLY". Each starter contains one empty dedicated 500 mL bottle and one matching sealed 20 mL cartridge. The pairs are B01/R01, B02/R02, B03/R03 and B04/R04. Customers retain that same bottle for their next matching refill.

All four pairs use P20: a bottle collar with 28 mm outer diameter, 18 mm opening and 10 mm band height; a cartridge shoulder of 28 mm diameter; and a stem with 16 mm outer diameter, 8 mm bore and 14 mm insertion length. Maximum external envelopes, including removable storage closures, are bottle 70 W × 65 D × 230 H mm, cartridge 60 W × 32 D × 110 H mm and starter carton 145 W × 90 D × 255 H mm. Develop the surrounding body shapes and carton structure around these dimensions. Use HDPE bottles, PP cartridges and closures, and 350 g/m² uncoated folding paperboard cartons. Front and back labels have fixed cutting outlines: 50 × 90 mm for bottles and 40 × 55 mm for cartridges, both with 2 mm corner radii and 3 mm text insets. The refill sequence runs through the existing station: retain and match, dock at P20, transfer 20 mL concentrate plus 480 mL station carrier, then remove and reclose the same bottle. Represent the station as a labelled system boundary. The combined display holds S01–S03 and R01–R03 within 600 W × 300 D × 450 H mm; each single-product display holds one matching starter and refill within 260 W × 220 D × 330 H mm.

Audience: households choosing their first dedicated bottle or their next matching refill, and our packaging and retail teams approving the range and shelf arrangement.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the identity, product records, complete package copy, materials and refill sequence. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable with its proportion, format and stage. interface-envelope.en.md records the P20 dimensions and maximum package envelopes. p20-interface-and-labels.png supplies the dimensioned interface, package envelopes and label cutting outlines. p20-connector-identity.png records the collar and insertion-stem geometry shared by the range. household-counter-reference.png provides the everyday kitchen atmosphere for use and display imagery.

Deliverables:
1. Two specification documents: a structural sheet recording P20, package dimensions, label outlines, materials and removable closures; and a copy-and-placement table containing the complete B01–B03, R01–R03 and S01–S03 wording and material marks
2. Three flat artwork boards, one each for PANE, SURFACE and FLOOR, each containing bottle and cartridge front and back labels and the complete starter carton dieline with dimensions, folds and glue area
3. Three assembled packaging boards, one each for PANE, SURFACE and FLOOR, each containing its dedicated bottle, sealed refill and closed starter carton, plus readable flat front and back labels for all three items
4. Two four-panel refill sequence boards, one for B01/R01 PANE and one for B02/R02 SURFACE, with the station transfer equation
5. Two retail displays: the combined S01–S03 and R01–R03 display, and a PANE display holding one S01 and one R01, each with dimensions and purchase headings
6. One 10-second PANE starter unboxing video showing the empty B01 bottle, sealed R01 cartridge and their matching labels
7. One range presentation of at least 8 pages reusing the specifications, flat artwork, assembled packaging, refill sequences, retail displays and video stills

Acceptance:
- The two specification documents establish the structural and copy records before the artwork. The structural sheet states every P20 dimension in the letter, 500 mL bottle capacity, 20 mL cartridge contents and the three material assignments; the copy-and-placement table records every front and back line for the nine specified items and locates 2 HDPE, 5 PP and 21 PAP on their corresponding back surfaces.
- The three flat artwork boards and three assembled packaging boards repeat the specifications' label dimensions, material names and capacity figures as board annotations. Their labels reproduce the copy table, use the assigned SKU accents with #F7F5EF and #233D45, and print RETURNHOUSE with the appropriate STARTER KIT or REFILL ONLY purchase message.
- The three flat artwork boards identify carton folds, glue areas and assembled dimensions within 145 × 90 × 255 mm; the assembled packaging boards retain the specified P20 geometry and keep bottles within 70 × 65 × 230 mm and cartridges within 60 × 32 × 110 mm.
- Both refill sequence boards show the four stated steps using their matching B/R pair, print 20 mL concentrate + 480 mL station carrier = 500 mL working fill, and carry Refill station required; not included in either pack. The 10-second video reveals one empty B01 bottle and one sealed R01 cartridge from S01 and ends with the corresponding R01 REFILL ONLY pack beside them.
- The combined retail display holds the six specified packs within 600 × 300 × 450 mm; the PANE display holds S01 and R01 within 260 × 220 × 330 mm. Both reuse the assembled packaging and print STARTER KIT, REFILL ONLY and Refill station required; not included.
- The presentation has at least 8 pages, identifies RETURNHOUSE on its first page and reuses every preceding deliverable category; its specification spread repeats the P20 dimensions, three material assignments, 500 mL and 20 mL quantities, base colour codes and material marks.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
